title: India Women Face Sri Lanka for Gold in Asian Games Cricket Final
excerpt: Harmanpreet Kaur's defending champions meet Sri Lanka for the Asian Games women's cricket gold at 10:30 AM IST on September 22, while boxer Sakshi Chaudhary opens against an Olympic medallist.
body:
• India meets Sri Lanka in the Asian Games women's cricket gold medal match at 10:30 AM IST on September 22, with the defending champions chasing back-to-back titles.
  • Boxer Sakshi Chaudhary opens her women's 51kg campaign in the Round of 32 against Olympic medallist Aira Villegas of the Philippines.
  • Medal chances also line up in wushu, shooting skeet finals and karate, while both badminton teams face Japan in the quarterfinals.
  • For US viewers, the cricket final starts at 10:00 PM PDT on Monday, September 21.

India's women's cricket team plays Sri Lanka for the gold medal at the Asian Games on Tuesday, September 22, headlining a packed Day 4 for the Indian contingent at Aichi-Nagoya. The final starts at 10:30 AM IST, with Harmanpreet Kaur's side bidding to defend the title it won on debut at the previous edition.

The final caps a tournament India has controlled from the top seed. Drawn against Japan in the quarterfinals on September 17, India advanced through its half of the bracket while Sri Lanka came through the other, dispatching Malaysia and their semifinal opponents to set up the title clash, according to the published women's cricket schedule.

Context & Background

Cricket returned to the Asian Games at Hangzhou, where India struck gold in the women's competition at the first attempt. The squad for the 2026 defense is built around experience: Harmanpreet Kaur captains, with Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma and Deepti Sharma anchoring a side that entered the Games as the team to beat. Eight nations contested the women's event this year, including automatic qualifiers India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh alongside hosts Japan and qualifiers China, Malaysia and Thailand.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=pJMuH9CA4fU

The draw was structured so that India and Pakistan, the two strongest sides, could meet only in the medal matches on September 22. Instead the bronze playoff and final were set without them: Sri Lanka, seeded third, earned its place in the gold-medal match. The men's tournament, led by Shreyas Iyer, runs on a separate schedule with its medal matches on October 3.

Impact & Analysis

The cricket final is the day's single biggest medal opportunity for India, but it is far from the only one. Boxer Sakshi Chaudhary faces the sternest possible opening test in the women's 51kg Round of 32 against Aira Villegas of the Philippines, an Olympic medallist. The bout is listed for 9:00 AM IST, and Villegas's pedigree makes it the most dangerous draw in India's early boxing schedule.

Shooting offers two finals: the men's skeet team final with Mairaj Ahmad Khan, Anant Jeet Singh Naruka and Bhavtegh Singh Gill, and the women's skeet team final featuring Parinaaz Dhaliwal, Raiza Dhillon and Maheshwari Chauhan. Elavenil Valarivan and Parth Rakesh Mane shoot the 10m air rifle mixed team qualification and, if they advance, the final. In wushu, Langlentombi Devi Hanjabam contests the women's nanquan and nandao finals, while karate's Alisha Choudhary has medal bouts on the schedule if she advances.

Badminton's day runs through Japan twice: the women's team quarterfinal at 6:00 AM IST and the men's team quarterfinal at 11:30 AM. The men's hockey team faces Sri Lanka in Pool A at 3:30 PM IST.

The cricket final carries weight beyond the medal. A second straight gold would cement India's claim as the dominant women's side in Asian multi-sport competition and validate a selection strategy that kept the core of the Hangzhou-winning group together.

Diaspora Angle

For Indian-Americans, the cricket final is a prime-time watch: 10:30 AM IST on September 22 is 10:00 PM PDT on Monday, September 21. Few Indian athletes command as much diaspora attention as Harmanpreet Kaur and Smriti Mandhana, whose following in the US has grown with every major tournament final.

What's Next

Win or lose, the women's cricket competition concludes on September 22, and attention shifts to the men's tournament, which builds toward its medal matches on October 3. India's broader medal tally hinges on how many of Tuesday's finals — wushu, skeet, karate and cricket — convert. The schedule then moves into the middle phase of the Games, with the athletics program still to come.
